name: Derek Tys
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker / Counsellor
description: I specialise in: Mentoring Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD-1) with Adults, Alcohol & Other Drugs, Art Therapy, LGBTIQA+, XXY & Intersex, Trauma, Attachment repair, and Dream work. I use EMDR & Flash Technique, PBSP, Transpersonal, Jungian, Art Therapy, and Sandplay approaches.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, LGBTIQA+, intersex, attachment repair, AOD, autism

name: Jesse Hooper
title: Accredited Mental Health Social Worker / Psychotherapist
description: Expertise working with adults experiencing anxiety, depression, grief, loss, and trauma. I bring counselling and psychotherapeutic skills gained from supporting people from the LGBTIQA+, CALD, and disability communities.

name: Margaretha Josephsohn
title: Accredited Social Worker & EMDR Therapist
description: I work from a trauma-informed, trauma-focused framework using evidence-based approaches including CBT, DBT, EMDR, Sandtray Therapy, and attachment-based interventions. I am a passionate ally of the LGBTQIA+ community.
specialties: EMDR, trauma, DBT, sandtray, LGBTQIA+ ally

name: Charlie Charlton
title: Psychotherapist (PACFA)
description: A trauma-informed psychotherapist... experience helping people with exploration of sexuality, gender and non-traditional relational structures. Draws on Attachment Theory, Internal Family Systems, EFT, Existential, Psychodynamic and Somatic Therapy.
specialties: trauma-informed, sexuality, gender, non-traditional relationships, IFS, grief, couples

name: Carol-Ann Allen
title: Psychotherapist (LMFT, PACFA Clinical Member)
description: I have worked within the widely diverse LGBTQ community for over 25 years, as a counsellor and psychotherapist... Same sex or gender diverse relationship challenges; early experiences of bullying or abuse.
specialties: LGBTQ, gender diverse, coming out, couples, family rejection

name: Angus Ferguson
title: Counsellor & Gestalt Psychotherapist
description: I am a counsellor and psychotherapist with a background in supporting people who identify as being queer. Anxiety, depression, intimate relationship concerns, alcohol and drug use; gestalt psychotherapy.

name: Shaun Williams
title: Counsellor (ACA)
description: A safe, inclusive space that supports mental health and positive change within the LGBTIQA+ community, particularly for those who identify as male. As a cis gay man and father... a proud Wotjobaluk man.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, gay men, couples, CBT, ACT

name: Andrew Macdonald
title: Psychotherapist & Counsellor
description: A service where you can feel supported in exploring sexuality, gender, sex and relationship challenges. LGBTIQA+ Counselling via Zoom video based appointments.
